description: `routes.probe` (S18 T3): the operator's ONE minimal request per route, and the verdict it earned. `saved` says the earned verdicts reached the store and survive a restart; `verified` and `contradicted` carry the instant they were measured and the model they were measured against (O2) — a cached verdict without them cannot be aged. A `declared` flag the probe could not settle appears with its reason and no timestamp: the probe never earned an opinion about it, and the declaration was never rewritten (I5). Nothing here fired on its own — M32 makes the operator's call the only door.

probes.detail: the request carried a tool declaration and the stream completed — the server accepted tools
the stream completed with no usage at all, although the adapter asked for usage in the stream by the provider's standard means
not cheaply probable: a silently-ignored system message looks exactly like a honoured one in one request
